chunks: Sahl ibn Ziyād narrated from some of his companions, from Abū Hammām Ismāʿīl ibn Hammām, from Abū al-Ḥasan al-Riḍā عليه السلام, who said:

Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام said when death was brought near him: “When I die, then dig and make for me a shaqq. If it is said to you that the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله was given a laḥd, they have indeed spoken the truth.”

key_terms.أُحْضِرَ: when death was brought near; when he was in the state of dying
key_terms.رَسُولَ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.شُقُّوا: make a side trench/opening in the grave
key_terms.لُحِدَ: a laḥd was made for him; a niche-style grave was prepared

ai.seo_question: What did Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام instruct about the grave when he was near death?
ai.summary: This hadith records a statement of Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام at the time of dying regarding the manner of preparing the grave. It indicates a burial-related ruling while also affirming what was done for the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم. The report is relevant to funeral jurisprudence and the transmitted sunnah concerning graves.
